# Code of Conduct

We are committed to a respectful, accessible, and constructive community for everyone who contributes to CareerFit AI.

Be considerate, welcome different perspectives, give actionable feedback, and respect people's privacy. Do not post resumes, API keys, passwords, or other personal information in issues or pull requests.

Report conduct concerns through the private reporting route available from the repository's GitHub Security tab when enabled. For general project questions, use the repository's issue tracker.
